note: Scorer-only. Never forwarded to a condition, prompt, retrieval index or agent. Paths under evaluation/ are excluded from normal source indexing. Each claim restates one required_fact of .agents/artifacts/t3code-scenarios.json; its witnesses are the minimal retained source passages (path + regex) a condition must deliver before that fact is supportable. Witness delivery is necessary, not sufficient, for a correct conclusion: the deterministic tier measures supportability, the agent tier measures stated conclusions.
verified_against: t3-eval-work/scratch on 2026-10-18 (every pattern matched exactly its listed path at authoring time)

claim_kinds.fact: What the code does or where it lives.
claim_kinds.condition: A precondition, guard, invariant or ordering rule that governs a change.
claim_kinds.exception: A boundary, limit or case where the obvious conclusion is wrong.
claim_kinds.verification: A test or check that distinguishes the behavior.
